upstream_dependencies.integration_rule: Treat legacy Python bridge execution as a historical research oracle. A current adapter may submit or observe typed operations, but it cannot publish ZenoLedger state or satisfy external finality.

selected_architecture.abi_v2_trigger: A new foundational effect category or invariant plus an approved typed delta, migration obligations, and compatibility policy.

semantic_anchors.asset_precision: Eight decimal places represented as unsigned integer atoms. Floats are forbidden in authoritative paths.
semantic_anchors.autonomous_governance: Autonomous governance and LLM agents may submit authenticated typed commands. They have no publication capability.
semantic_anchors.buy_and_burn: Spend the governed quote-asset fee allocation through the release-selected Spot route and burn the exact ZDEX atoms received.
semantic_anchors.hosting_compensation: A separately named governed fee allocation with explicit eligibility, claimant, expiry, cancellation, and terminal-drain semantics.
semantic_anchors.hyperdeflation: No fixed percentage of initial supply is required as a floor. Each burn obeys a profile-bound retained-supply rule and cannot exceed current supply minus retained supply.
semantic_anchors.rescaling: No denomination rescaling under GlobalSettlementABI V1.
semantic_anchors.accounting_language: Key control determines practical custody. Same-ledger values are described by accounting location, accounting control domain, claimant entitlement, and key authority.
semantic_anchors.external_lane: The registered external lane starts empty. Unregistered destinations reject without mutation.
semantic_anchors.tau_role: Current Tau may authenticate or order typed command occurrences and may govern policy predicates. Tau does not receive a separate durable publication path.

baseline_verdict.estimate_warning: This is an immutable diagnosis of the implementation base. Live progress belongs in exact-subject obligation and value-movement ledgers. coordination_protocol.candidate_rule: Each worker candidate is one direct child of the declared integration head. A dirty subject invalidates the packet.
coordination_protocol.shared_file_rule: Registries, ledgers, manifests, semantic contracts, and shared ABI files are integrator-owned. Workers request shared changes instead of editing them concurrently.
coordination_protocol.test_rule: The minimized BEFORE witness must fail on the parent and the AFTER evidence must pass on the child and on the post-integration head.
promotion_order: independent review of the exact integrated candidate
coordination_protocol.stop_rule: Stop or reformulate a workstream after two review cycles with no closed-obligation delta.
coordination_protocol.progress_metric: Closed value-movement gates and closed capability rows. Commits, tests, lines, and compute are supporting telemetry.
coordination_protocol.cost_metric: Record wall time, compute, changed lines, and review rounds per newly closed obligation.
